# --- Phase 6 Computations ---
# This script calculates all the necessary figures for the Advanced Analysis & Root Cause Investigation.

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

# --- 1. Data Preparation (as per previous phases) ---
print("--- 1. Data Preparation ---")

# Fix TotalCharges
df['TotalCharges'] = pd.to_numeric(df['TotalCharges'], errors='coerce')
df['TotalCharges'].fillna(0, inplace=True)

# Standardize SeniorCitizen
df['SeniorCitizen'] = df['SeniorCitizen'].map({0: 'No', 1: 'Yes'})

# Map Churn to numeric
df['Churn_num'] = df['Churn'].map({'Yes': 1, 'No': 0})

# Engineered Features
# a. tenure_group
bins = [0, 12, 24, 48, 72]
labels = ['0-12 Months', '13-24 Months', '25-48 Months', '49-72 Months']
# Include the lower bound, handle tenure=0
df['tenure_group'] = pd.cut(df['tenure'], bins=bins, labels=labels, right=True, include_lowest=True)

# b. num_optional_services
service_cols = ['OnlineSecurity', 'OnlineBackup', 'DeviceProtection', 'TechSupport', 'StreamingTV', 'StreamingMovies']
df['num_optional_services'] = (df[service_cols] == 'Yes').sum(axis=1)

print("Data preparation complete. New columns 'Churn_num', 'tenure_group', 'num_optional_services' created.")
print(f"Shape of prepared data: {df.shape}")
print("\n")


# --- 2. Root Cause Chain & Segment Deep Dive Figures ---
print("--- 2. Root Cause & Deep Dive Figures ---")

# H1: Contract x Internet Service Interaction
print("--- H1: Contract x Internet Service Interaction ---")
interaction_churn = df.groupby(['Contract', 'InternetService'])['Churn_num'].mean().unstack()
print("Churn Rate by Contract and Internet Service:")
print(interaction_churn)
print("\nSpecific high-risk segment (Fiber optic, Month-to-month):")
fiber_m2m_churn = df[(df['InternetService'] == 'Fiber optic') & (df['Contract'] == 'Month-to-month')]['Churn_num'].mean()
print(f"Churn Rate: {fiber_m2m_churn:.1%}")
print(f"Segment Size: {len(df[(df['InternetService'] == 'Fiber optic') & (df['Contract'] == 'Month-to-month')])} customers")
print("\n")

# H2: High Early-Life Churn
print("--- H2: High Early-Life Churn ---")
early_life_churn_12m = df[df['tenure'] <= 12]['Churn_num'].mean()
print(f"Churn rate for tenure <= 12 months: {early_life_churn_12m:.1%}")
print(f"Segment Size (<= 12 months): {len(df[df['tenure'] <= 12])} customers")

early_life_churn_3m = df[df['tenure'] <= 3]['Churn_num'].mean()
print(f"Churn rate for tenure <= 3 months: {early_life_churn_3m:.1%}")
print(f"Segment Size (<= 3 months): {len(df[df['tenure'] <= 3])} customers")


# H2 Deep Dive: Early life churn x Fiber Optic
print("\n--- H2 Deep Dive: Early life churn for Fiber Optic customers ---")
early_life_fiber_churn_3m = df[(df['tenure'] <= 3) & (df['InternetService'] == 'Fiber optic')]['Churn_num'].mean()
print(f"Churn rate for Fiber Optic customers with tenure <= 3 months: {early_life_fiber_churn_3m:.1%}")
print(f"Segment Size (Fiber, <= 3 months): {len(df[(df['tenure'] <= 3) & (df['InternetService'] == 'Fiber optic')])} customers")
print("\n")


# H3: High Churn for Electronic Check
print("--- H3: High Churn for Electronic Check ---")
payment_churn = df.groupby('PaymentMethod')['Churn_num'].agg(['mean', 'count'])
payment_churn.rename(columns={'mean': 'churn_rate'}, inplace=True)
print("Churn Rate by Payment Method:")
print(payment_churn)
print("\n")

# H4/H5: Add-ons and Demographics
print("--- H4/H5: Bivariate Churn Rates for other key variables ---")
print("\nChurn Rate by TechSupport:")
print(df.groupby('TechSupport')['Churn_num'].agg(['mean', 'count']))
print("\nChurn Rate by OnlineSecurity:")
print(df.groupby('OnlineSecurity')['Churn_num'].agg(['mean', 'count']))
print("\nChurn Rate by SeniorCitizen:")
print(df.groupby('SeniorCitizen')['Churn_num'].agg(['mean', 'count']))
print("\n")


# --- 3. Confound Sweep Calculations ---
print("--- 3. Confound Sweep Calculations ---")

# Confound Sweep for Finding: High churn for Month-to-Month contracts
print("--- Confound Sweep for Month-to-Month Churn Rate ---")
m2m_churn_by_senior = df[df['Contract'] == 'Month-to-month'].groupby('SeniorCitizen')['Churn_num'].mean()
print("\nM2M Churn Rate by SeniorCitizen:")
print(m2m_churn_by_senior)

m2m_churn_by_dependents = df[df['Contract'] == 'Month-to-month'].groupby('Dependents')['Churn_num'].mean()
print("\nM2M Churn Rate by Dependents:")
print(m2m_churn_by_dependents)

m2m_churn_by_billing = df[df['Contract'] == 'Month-to-month'].groupby('PaperlessBilling')['Churn_num'].mean()
print("\nM2M Churn Rate by PaperlessBilling:")
print(m2m_churn_by_billing)

# Confound Sweep for Finding: High churn for Fiber Optic
print("\n--- Confound Sweep for Fiber Optic Churn Rate ---")
fiber_churn_by_senior = df[df['InternetService'] == 'Fiber optic'].groupby('SeniorCitizen')['Churn_num'].mean()
print("\nFiber Optic Churn Rate by SeniorCitizen:")
print(fiber_churn_by_senior)

fiber_churn_by_dependents = df[df['InternetService'] == 'Fiber optic'].groupby('Dependents')['Churn_num'].mean()
print("\nFiber Optic Churn Rate by Dependents:")
print(fiber_churn_by_dependents)

# Confound Candidate Check: Marketing Campaign Signature
print("\n--- Confound Candidate Check: Marketing Campaign Signature ---")
print("Number of churners by month of tenure (first 12 months):")
churners_by_tenure = df[df['Churn'] == 'Yes']['tenure'].value_counts().sort_index()
print(churners_by_tenure.head(12))
print("\n")


# --- 4. Impact Quantification Figures ---
print("--- 4. Impact Quantification Figures ---")

# a. Electronic Check Intervention
print("--- Impact: Electronic Check Intervention ---")
ec_customers = payment_churn.loc['Electronic check', 'count']
ec_churn_rate = payment_churn.loc['Electronic check', 'churn_rate']
bt_churn_rate = payment_churn.loc['Bank transfer (automatic)', 'churn_rate']
ec_churners = ec_customers * ec_churn_rate
potential_churners_saved = ec_customers * (ec_churn_rate - bt_churn_rate)
print(f"Total customers on Electronic check: {ec_customers}")
print(f"Current churners on Electronic check: {ec_churners:.0f}")
print(f"Potential churners saved by switching to Bank Transfer rates: {potential_churners_saved:.0f}")
print("\n")

# b. Month-to-Month Contract Intervention
print("--- Impact: Month-to-Month Contract Intervention ---")
m2m_churn_table = df.groupby('Contract')['Churn_num'].agg(['mean', 'count'])
m2m_customers = m2m_churn_table.loc['Month-to-month', 'count']
m2m_churn_rate = m2m_churn_table.loc['Month-to-month', 'mean']
one_yr_churn_rate = m2m_churn_table.loc['One year', 'mean']
m2m_churners = m2m_customers * m2m_churn_rate
potential_churners_saved_m2m = m2m_customers * (m2m_churn_rate - one_yr_churn_rate)
print(f"Total customers on Month-to-month: {m2m_customers}")
print(f"Current churners on Month-to-month: {m2m_churners:.0f}")
print(f"Potential churners saved by switching to One Year rates: {potential_churners_saved_m2m:.0f}")
print("\n")

# c. Early-Life Intervention (0-3 months)
print("--- Impact: Early-Life Intervention (0-3 months) ---")
early_life_cust_3m = len(df[df['tenure'] <= 3])
early_life_churners_3m = df[df['tenure'] <= 3]['Churn_num'].sum()
overall_churn_rate_after_3m = df[df['tenure'] > 3]['Churn_num'].mean()
potential_churners_saved_early = early_life_cust_3m * (early_life_churn_3m - overall_churn_rate_after_3m)
print(f"Total customers with tenure <= 3 months: {early_life_cust_3m}")
print(f"Current churners with tenure <= 3 months: {early_life_churners_3m}")
print(f"Churn rate for customers with tenure > 3 months: {overall_churn_rate_after_3m:.1%}")
print(f"Potential churners saved by reducing early churn to baseline: {potential_churners_saved_early:.0f}")
print("\n")


# --- 5. Logistic Regression Model (Red Team Requirement: No TotalCharges) ---
print("--- 5. Logistic Regression Model (No TotalCharges) ---")

# Define features
# Drop customerID, Churn, Churn_num, and the engineered group/count features for this model
# Drop TotalCharges as per Red Team instruction
features = df.drop(columns=['customerID', 'Churn', 'Churn_num', 'tenure_group', 'num_optional_services', 'TotalCharges'])
target = df['Churn_num']

# Identify categorical and numerical features
categorical_features = features.select_dtypes(include=['object']).columns
numerical_features = features.select_dtypes(include=np.number).columns

# Create preprocessing pipelines for numerical and categorical features
numerical_transformer = StandardScaler()
categorical_transformer = OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore', drop='first')

# Create a column transformer to apply different transformations to different columns
preprocessor = ColumnTransformer(
    transformers=[
        ('num', numerical_transformer, numerical_features),
        ('cat', categorical_transformer, categorical_features)
    ])

# Create the logistic regression pipeline
log_reg_pipeline = Pipeline(steps=[('preprocessor', preprocessor),
                                   ('classifier', LogisticRegression(random_state=42, max_iter=1000, solver='liblinear'))])

# Split data and fit model
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(features, target, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=target)
log_reg_pipeline.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Get feature names after one-hot encoding
ohe_feature_names = log_reg_pipeline.named_steps['preprocessor'].named_transformers_['cat'].get_feature_names_out(categorical_features)
all_feature_names = list(numerical_features) + list(ohe_feature_names)

# Get coefficients and odds ratios
coefficients = log_reg_pipeline.named_steps['classifier'].coef_[0]
odds_ratios = np.exp(coefficients)

# Create a DataFrame for results
results_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'Feature': all_feature_names,
    'Coefficient': coefficients,
    'Odds_Ratio': odds_ratios
}).sort_values(by='Odds_Ratio', ascending=False)

print("Logistic Regression Model Results (Top 10 predictors of Churn):")
print(results_df.head(10))
print("\nLogistic Regression Model Results (Top 10 predictors of Retention):")
print(results_df.tail(10).sort_values(by='Odds_Ratio', ascending=True))
print("\n")


# --- 6. Chi-squared Tests for Hypotheses (as in Phase 5) for reference ---
print("--- 6. Chi-squared Test Statistics (for reference) ---")

# H3: PaymentMethod
contingency_pm = pd.crosstab(df['PaymentMethod'], df['Churn'])
chi2_pm, p_pm, _, _ = chi2_contingency(contingency_pm)
print(f"Chi-squared test for PaymentMethod vs Churn: chi2 = {chi2_pm:.4f}, p-value = {p_pm}")

# H4: TechSupport
contingency_ts = pd.crosstab(df['TechSupport'], df['Churn'])
# Filter out 'No internet service' as it has a very low churn rate and can skew results if included
contingency_ts_filtered = contingency_ts.loc[['No', 'Yes']]
chi2_ts, p_ts, _, _ = chi2_contingency(contingency_ts_filtered)
print(f"Chi-squared test for TechSupport (Yes/No) vs Churn: chi2 = {chi2_ts:.4f}, p-value = {p_ts}")


# H5: SeniorCitizen
contingency_sc = pd.crosstab(df['SeniorCitizen'], df['Churn'])
chi2_sc, p_sc, _, _ = chi2_contingency(contingency_sc)
print(f"Chi-squared test for SeniorCitizen vs Churn: chi2 = {chi2_sc:.4f}, p-value = {p_sc}")
print("\n--- End of Computations ---")
